subject: planner: fix the issue that the optimizer terminates the optimization process for `DataSource` too early (#48186)
summary: Change introduces fix-control-gated exploration of enforced plans for `DataSource` (Fix46177) to avoid prematurely returning after finding a keep-order (unenforced) access path; it then compares enforced vs. unenforced task costs and adds integration coverage for Issue #46177. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found in the planner changes; later history on `upstream/master` retains this behavior (and eventually flips the default of Fix46177 to enabled).
